D5/S0/Diagonal/Lawvere/QualitativeEscape.name: D5.S0.Diagonal.Lawvere.QualitativeEscape.self_application_fragment_package
D5/S0/Diagonal/Lawvere/QualitativeEscape.signature: theorem self_application_fragment_package (f : Y → Y) (g : A → A → Y) : (∀ a : A, diagonal f g a = f (g a a)) ∧ (IsEscaped f g ↔ diagonal f g ∉ Set.range g) ∧ ((∀ y, f y ≠ y) → ∀ h : A → A → Y, IsEscaped f h) ∧ (∃ (f₀ : Bool → Bool) (g₀ : Unit → Unit → Bool), ¬ IsEscaped f₀ g₀)
